inputs.note: MODE: synthetic — a VisionExtractor that raises VisionFailure(MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID). No recording needed: the assertion is about what the worker does with a model that returned nothing usable.

expected: Unparseable model output produces status=failed with failure_reason=model_output_invalid and NO payload.
guards_against: A partial extraction returned beside a non-complete status (D7). Up to 73.7% unparseable JSON has been measured for some models on medical IE, so this is the common failure, not the exotic one.
